title: Mirai Labs clone — PageSpec
description: A generated page composition: a declared template plus an ordered list of section nodes, each carrying its own content + motion (+ assetRefs where applicable). Word-count (maxWords) budgets and template/node cross-referencing are enforced in schema/semantic_validate.py, not here (see tokens/llm/token-policy.json).

responsive.description: Structured, per-section responsive behavior keyed to real breakpoint tokens from tokens/00-foundation/breakpoint.json. A generator must be able to read this without parsing prose.

citation.description: Required (and only meaningful) when noResponsiveChange is true — cites the exact grep/range showing no responsive class is present.
